Staff reading this section are responsible for applying it carefully, consistently, and with kindness.

Companion Animal Travel Desk: Animal Travel Handling
Purpose: This section explains how to receive animal travel requests, check supporting documents, and guide passengers with steady, humane service.

Staff must speak in a warm, professional tone and keep the animal's comfort in view at every step. When a passenger raises a concern, listen fully, avoid rushing the discussion, and explain the next step in clear plain words. Handle each case with calm judgment and refer unusual situations to the senior coordinator without delay. If a traveler like Felix Brown or Khalil Schneider brings questions about a pet such as Sasha, give the same patient treatment you would give any family traveling with an animal.

For bird travel, confirm that the animal meets the applicable entry and carrier rules before any booking is completed. <<FACT F077>> Do not promise acceptance until the review is complete, and keep all notes brief, accurate, and respectful. If the animal appears stressed, pause the process and suggest a quieter setting for the conversation.

For rabbit travel, review the health certificate with care and check that all other required papers are present and readable. <<FACT F082>> If anything is missing or unclear, tell the passenger what still needs to be provided and offer the next appropriate step in a calm manner. Never guess at a document's status, and never pressure the passenger to hurry beyond what the process allows.

When a case must move to another desk or level of review, keep the handoff smooth and documented. <<FACT F106>> Use the approved transfer path, note the reason for escalation, and tell the passenger who will continue the review. If a situation feels sensitive or the passenger is distressed, the senior coordinator should be informed promptly so the matter can be handled with care.

For any uncertain case, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at Aurelia Skyways for guidance.
